styleLock.backgroundSystem: bright airy white and warm cream panels with light-wood tabletop accents and fresh citrus produce garnish
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadow; natural warm window light about 5500K in lifestyle shots
styleLock.surfaceSystem: light natural wood and matte cream stone tabletops
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for all headlines and labels; short 「」-wrapped Chinese callouts only
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line #F28C1E icons in rounded circle chips, consistent stroke weight
styleLock.presentationRules: bottle always upright and centered with stable scale; hero angle kept consistent across hero and variant shots; full product visible in hero, softly cropped in mid-shots
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm vitality nutrition ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, warm cream panels #FFF6EC, deep cocoa text #5C3A1E, and one vibrant orange accent #F28C1E; warm tone; modern geometric sans-serif with short 「」-wrapped callouts; bright airy backgrounds with light wood surfaces and fresh citrus produce accents; bright soft studio light with front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadow; consistent rounded rectangular badge and label style; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright bottle scale and centered placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 8 张详情页切片提炼。主产品依图判定为维生素C咀嚼片（橙子味、高浓VC钙片、可嚼、一嚼即化），为片剂而非泡腾片，与库内「维生素C泡腾片」模版按剂型与卖点（水果等量换算、口感、便携）明确区分；与源夹名「保健/维C」判断一致，无冲突。panel-07/08 为素材店广告（二维码、店铺水印、纯色填充块），无产品信息，未映射分镜；素材店 logo/水印、源文案（剂量数字、功效词如预防感冒/美白）与手写体标题全部剥离，统一转为 {selling_point}/{callout} 槽位；模特与品牌信息源图未出现。柑橘水果道具属果味营养品的通用视觉语法，可随产品口味替换。
